depends_on: v2/backend/app/composition/trainer_parity/runtime.py (parity monitor; this task adds a real subprocess wrapper for the legacy trainer binary OR a V2-native trainer service)
prompt: Build the V2 trainer bridge. Two acceptable forms: (a) a subprocess wrapper invoking the frozen legacy trainer binary in a sandboxed read-only mode and capturing its predictions into a V2 stream, OR (b) a V2-native trainer service that produces predictions without touching legacy state. Either form must NOT mutate legacy trainer state directories. When the legacy binary is unavailable, emit MISSING_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE classification rather than synthesizing. Trigger codex_review_v2_trainer_bridge on emit.
